chapter: Instruments, own band and the Eureka
title: Forming his own band after the Bulls and playing with Eureka
summary: After the Bulls he led his own band with Dude Gabriel, Keto, Charlie Moore and young drummer Percy, and later played with the Eureka Brass Band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, let's get back. So you played with the Bulls, huh?
I was playing during that time. They're in the Mobile Bulls now. They're all in the supply.
And then after you left the Bulls, who did you go with?

I got my own band. And who was in that? Oh, I can't call all the fellas then. Dude Gabriel on clarinet, Keto on the drum, Charlie Moore on the banjo. And who else? A fella from up in Corbin, he used to play bass. I forgot his name. I had Percy on the drum.

Well, he was pretty, around about 18, 19 years old. He played drum with me about two years. He didn't drink them. So I meet him at the Bulls. He said, Well, Mr. Son, I'm drinking whiskey now. I'm trumpet player. I'm drinking whiskey. Yeah. He played with me a good while. Two years or three years he played.
Do you remember Pete Baddy? Baddy, no. Oh, yeah, Pete Baddy.
Mm-hmm. Satisfone player? Mm-hmm. Yeah, I know him. He's dead, ain't he?
I think so. I think his son played.
Last time I played with Eureka Bass Band, we were a rehearsal up at his house up there, called him.
You were playing with Eureka? Yeah, I played with Eureka. Are you in the union now?
